supersede_scope: protocol revision performed before any formal 500-epoch run, i.e. before any MMFR result exists
supersede_reason: four audited protocol defects: (1) severity was encoded twice for gaussian_noise/blur/quantization, (2) blur and misalignment severity were absolute pixel quantities and therefore not equivalent across the 480x640 training crop and the original 932x1082 aligned grid, (3) the Depth reliability target ignored native MUSeg Depth invalidity, and (4) the RGB reliability channel was scored although it is a constant all-ones scaffold

stage_semantics.a1: synthetic failure generation plus a corruption-derived reliability surrogate
stage_semantics.a2: Depth corruption robustness training plus parallel reliability estimation
stage_semantics.a2_attribution_boundary: the predicted reliability does not enter the segmentation backbone, the decoder or the geometry prior, so an A2 segmentation gain cannot be attributed to the reliability head; the reliability head carries estimator qualification only in this stage
stage_semantics.b1: the first genuinely reliability-aware segmentation stage: the first stage in which predicted reliability influences a DFormerv2 model action

model_architecture_description: DFormerv2-S is an asymmetric RGB-primary semantic path plus Depth geometry-prior path: Depth enters as a geometry prior consumed by the geometry-aware self-attention, it is not a second explicitly encoded semantic branch, and the two modalities are not symmetric semantic encoders

training.reliability_supervision: continuous BCE on the Depth channel only

a1_corruption_basis.single_encoding_definition: severity only selects the corruption parameter; the continuous burden of gaussian_noise, blur and quantization is the realized normalized damage clip(max_channel_abs_delta / (255 * DAMAGE_REFERENCE), 0, 1), and severity is never applied a second time
a1_corruption_basis.relative_scale_rule: blur sigma and misalignment displacement are fractions of the actual grid converted to pixels per resolution; gaussian_noise and quantization remain intensity-space corruptions defined in the input representation space
a1_corruption_basis.misalignment_in_bounds_burden: min(1, displacement_px / reference_displacement_px) with reference_displacement_px = hypot(frac * H, frac * W)
a1_corruption_basis.structural_burden_values: entire_missing and spatial_dropout produce burden values in {0, MISSING_BURDEN} only
a1_corruption_basis.corruption_character: these are model-input / representation-level synthetic corruptions; they are not a Kinect physical noise model and must not be reported as measured sensor noise
a1_corruption_basis.monotonicity_requirement: a larger severity must produce a monotone non-decreasing realized damage and burden mean and a monotone non-increasing reliability target

depth_validity_and_supervision.clean_sample_target_semantics: natively valid Depth pixel target = 1, natively invalid (raw Depth == 0) pixel target = 0
depth_validity_and_supervision.rgb_channel_role: the RGB channel of the [B, 2, H, W] head output stays an all-ones scaffold channel: it is not scored, no calibration metric is reported for it, and it must not be called a trained RGB reliability estimator; B1 may consume Depth reliability only until a separate RGB corruption / B2 protocol exists
depth_validity_and_supervision.pad_semantics: crop/pad pixels keep the neutral target 1 and are excluded by valid_mask; normalized pad stays exact 0 and raw pad stays 0

invalidity_census.balance_rationale: gaussian_noise and misalignment can turn a natively invalid (raw Depth == 0) pixel into a nonzero one; those pixels are counted explicitly as newly_valid_pixels instead of being merged into either source population

backward once with lambda_rel = 0 and once with lambda_rel = 0.1

compare every DFormerv2 backbone, decoder and geometry-prior parameter gradient (all parameters not prefixed reliability_estimator.) and require equality inside the predefined floating point tolerance

gradient_path_isolation.statement_to_freeze_after_pass: the direct cause of an A2 segmentation change is corruption exposure; in this stage the reliability head carries estimator qualification only
gradient_path_isolation.why_this_replaces_an_extra_run: the passing isolation check establishes the mathematical fact that the reliability auxiliary loss cannot change the shared segmentation gradients, so a separate 500-epoch corruption-only control run is not required to demonstrate it

r1_reliability_supplemental.role: independent three-layer reliability report; layers 1 and 2 can never replace the primary robustness score and layer 3 is answerable only after B1

b1_frozen_design_principles: reliability is a condition, not an action: the fusion action must be learned from the segmentation objective
the action must never be set equal to the reliability value or to a corruption mask
the adapter must receive both stage-specific Depth reliability and the current-stage semantic/context information
spatial reliability structure must be preserved under local failures; a global mean/std alone is insufficient
prefer modulating the Depth-Spatial prior fusion strength or the influence of the geometry prior in the geometry-aware self-attention instead of hard-disabling the Depth contribution
every new modulation layer must be zero-init or no-op-init so the initial behaviour is exactly the old DFormerv2 behaviour, and modulation must be continuous rather than a 0/1 gate
b1_boundaries.dvg_b1_oracle_negative_result_interpreta: knowing where the input is broken does not tell the model which action to take; the oracle-not-supported result stays valid and is not rewritten by this revision

b2_boundaries.cmnext_caveat: CMNeXt must not be treated as a direct template for RGB-complete-missing because it is explicitly built on the assumption that the RGB representation is essential in a primary RGB branch

execution_profile.selection_rule: prefer RTX 4090 when available and the frozen batch fits; use RTX 5090 only when 4090 is unavailable, 24GB is insufficient, or a paired cloud probe measures throughput ratio above the price ratio
